title: Send feedback
introTeam: Something not working, or something missing? Tell the Ronde team: we read every message.
introAdmins: Something not working, or something missing? Your message goes to the administrators of this Ronde server.

placeholders.bug: What happened? What did you expect instead?
placeholders.idea: What would make Ronde better for you or your team?
placeholders.other: What would you like to tell us?

pasteHint: or paste or drop one here
screenshotCheck: Check it before sending: it shows what was on your screen.
contact: You may answer me by email
sentWith: Sent along: the address of this page, your browser, the window size, your language and the version of Ronde.
failed: The message could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
offline: No connection: the message was not sent. It stays here: try again once you are back online.
imageUnreadable: This image cannot be read. Try a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
captureFailed: The page could not be captured. You can add an image instead.
doneTeam: Your message reached the Ronde team.
doneAdmins: Your message reached the administrators of this server.
doneContact: If anything needs clarifying, you will get an answer by email.
doneContactAt: If anything needs clarifying, you will get an answer at {email}.
